products.name: BPC-157 - 10mg
products.description: BPC-157 (Body Protective Compound-157) is a synthetic peptide—a lab-made chain of 15 amino acids—modeled after a protein found in human gastric juice. (HEALING)

products.name: GHK-CU - 100mg
products.description: GHK-Cu (glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine copper) is a naturally occurring copper-binding tripeptide found in human plasma, saliva, and urine. Discovered in 1973, it acts as a copper carrier and signaling molecule involved in tissue repair, regeneration, and remodeling. (HEALING/REPAIR)

products.name: MOTS-C - 10mg
products.description: MOTS-c (Mitochondrial ORF of the 12S rRNA Type-C) is a 16-amino-acid peptide encoded by the mitochondrial genome that helps regulate cellular energy and metabolic stress. Discovered in 2015, it acts as a signaling molecule that responds to exercise and metabolic stress to influence glucose and fat metabolism. (HEALTH/STAMINA)

products.name: MT-2 - 10mg
products.description: Melanotan II (MT-2) is a synthetic, lab-made cyclic peptide of seven amino acids that mimics the natural hormone alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (α-MSH). (TANNING/LIBIDO)

products.name: RT10 - 10mg
products.description: Retatrutide (also known as LY-3437943) is an investigational, once-weekly injectable peptide being developed by Eli Lilly and Company for obesity, type 2 diabetes, and related metabolic conditions. It is a "triple agonist" that activates three hormone receptors—GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon—and is currently in Phase III clinical trials rather than approved for commercial or therapeutic use. (WEIGHT)

products.name: RT20 - 20mg

products.name: Semaglutide - 10mg
products.description: Semaglutide is a GLP-1 receptor agonist prescription medication used alongside diet and exercise to manage type 2 diabetes and chronic weight. (WEIGHT)

products.name: Sustanon 250mg
products.description: Sustanon 250 is an injectable androgenic medicine containing four testosterone esters in oil, primarily prescribed to treat confirmed testosterone deficiency (hypogonadism) in men. (GORILLA-LBS)

products.name: TB-500 - 10mg
products.description: TB-500 (Ac-LKKTETQ) is a synthetic, seven-amino-acid peptide fragment based on the active sequence (amino acids 17–23) of thymosin beta-4, a naturally occurring protein involved in cell movement and tissue repair. It is widely promoted online for injury recovery and wound healing. (HEALING)

products.name: Testosterone enanthate - 250mg
products.description: Testosterone enanthate is a long-acting, injectable esterified form of the natural hormone testosterone used primarily as replacement therapy for low or absent testosterone.Biological activity: Once cleaved in the body, free testosterone binds directly to androgen receptors or converts into dihydrotestosterone (DHT) or estradiol to support male sex characteristics, muscle mass, and bone density.

products.name: Testosterone Suspension - 100mg
products.description:
• Unesterified Formula: Because no ester group is attached, the body absorbs it quickly once injected.
• Rapid Onset & Short Duration: It enters the bloodstream rapidly and clears much faster than long-acting oil-based esters (such as testosterone cypionate, enanthate, or undecanoate), causing sharper peaks and quicker drops in blood levels.

products.name: TRENABOL - 100mg
products.description: Trenbolone is a potent synthetic anabolic-androgenic steroid (AAS) in the nandrolone group, originally developed for veterinary use in livestock to increase muscle growth and appetite. It is not approved for human medical use. (GORILLA-LBS)
